text:
erin: Flagging a weird flake in the next-starter-template that surfaced in the eval harness. Short repro attached in the gist.

mike_dx: Got it. Symptoms? 401s, partial streams, timeouts?

erin: 401 during token rotation window. SDK retries but appears to replay with the old token in a small race, producing truncated outputs that the harness flags. This only happens when the example runs with runtime: 'edge'.

tara: Which SDK version is the template using?

merike_dx: Template had @redwood/sdk pinned to 0.12.0. We shipped a refresh-concurrency patch in 0.12.3.

erin: Also noticed some platforms don't expose build-time env in edge the same way, so Authorization can be blank if devs follow the quickstart verbatim. Confusing DX.

mike_dx: Proposed fixes: 1) bump example SDK to 0.12.3+, 2) add a top-level guard in api route that throws a clear error if the key is missing, 3) add an "Edge gotchas" snippet to README, and 4) add a tiny msw-based integration test that simulates token expiry so the harness won't be surprised.

tara: For the harness side: treat 401 as potentially transient during rotation. Add 3 retries with exponential backoff before marking the job failed. That mirrors production behavior and reduces noisy flakes.

erin: I'll open the PR to bump the SDK and add the guard + README blurb. Mike, can you sketch the msw test?

mike_dx: Yep. Test plan: start the example handler, msw returns 401 for the first /v1/chat request, msw responds to the token refresh endpoint with a new token, then the second /v1/chat succeeds with full stream. Assert final output includes expected marker text. Keep it unit-speed so CI stays fast.

ci-bot: Created issue #3344: "next-starter-template: edge + token rotation can cause intermittent 401 and truncated eval output" assigned to erin 0 https://issues.redwood/3344

devex-bot: PR created: examples/next-starter#104 - bump @redwood/sdk -> 0.12.3; add env guard; add msw integration test.

erin: Thanks all  once PR merges QA please re-run the harness and unflag the job if green. Adding the README note should cut support pings for this.

tara: Agreed. Small DX changes, big onboarding win. :sparkles:
